title: Pan-Seared Haddock à la Française
description: A classic French-inspired dish featuring pan-seared haddock served with a crispy crust and a side of toasted bread.
instructions: Season the haddock fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat the butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the haddock fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the bread slices until crispy.
Serve the haddock fillets with the toasted bread and a sprinkle of chopped shallots.
